summary_text: Key near-term catalyst: execution on record 527,000-room pipeline and shift toward lower/mid-tier demand; international unit growth. Biggest risk: sluggish RevPAR in core markets capping profitability. New brand growth: Spark (few thousand units potential), Outset midscale lifestyle brand launched Oct 2025 (500 properties potential in N. America long term). Hilton raised FY2026 earnings guidance: net income $1,909M-$1,937M, diluted EPS $8.28-$8.40. Positioned to benefit from 2026 World Cup. Recent earnings beat with dividend hike and cautious 2026 guidance.
